title: HOTSPOT TEST
question: Do the strongest modeled dynamic hotspot edges occupy distinctive local network positions that are not captured by structural male/female weight difference alone?

hotspots.primary: top 1% edges by max integrated total-effect magnitude S
hotspots.secondary: top 1% edges by max integrated context residual C

matched_controls.control_choice: same structural bin; minimize abs total-weight difference, then abs abs-weight-difference difference, then edge_id ASC
matched_controls.failure_rule: if no unused control exists in the exact structural bin, record unmatched; do not widen bins post hoc

claim_boundary: SQ-03F may describe local network-position features associated with the frozen model's strongest dynamic hotspot edges after deterministic structural matching. It does not establish a biological sex mechanism, biological population effect, organism-level behavior, or causal importance outside the MoscaQuant model.
